page_title: AI Photo Generator: Create and Edit Photos Online

sources.entry: PhotoGenerAI - Free AI photo generator and editor — create and edit photos in the browser, no sign-up required. #freemium

summary.name: PhotoGenerAI
summary.one_liner: PhotoGenerAI is a browser-based AI photo generator and editor that creates images from text prompts or edits uploaded photos using models such as GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, FLUX and Qwen.
use_cases: Generate a photo from a text description
Change the background or lighting of an existing photo
Try different outfits on a person's photo
Create product mockups and lifestyle product shots
Preview a room redesign or tattoo idea on a photo of the space or skin
Combine a character with a new pose or scene
summary.what_it_does: The site generates images from a text prompt or from uploaded photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP), with optional aspect ratios and reference images. Users can edit photos in everyday language, such as removing objects, changing backgrounds, or adjusting lighting, and continue editing a result. It offers several workflows including sketch-to-image, combining subjects from separate photos, character pose transfer, outfit changes and product mockups. A chat-based agent and a canvas workflow builder let users refine images and save editing steps. Model choice and quality settings are shown with their credit cost before generating.
notable: Lets you choose between GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, FLUX and Qwen models in one editor
Three free generations without an account; signed-in users get up to 10 free credits per week
Agent canvas for chat-based editing and saveable, re-runnable editing workflows
caveats: Free credits only cover GPT Image 2 Low; Medium, High, and other models need purchased credits
Free use is limited to 3 generations without an account and 10 credits per week when signed in
